hints.title: Deterministic Path Identification
hints.text: Notice that in a tree, there is exactly one simple path between any pair of nodes. Trace the path from Bob's start node to root node 0 to find his exact arrival timestamp at each node on his trajectory.

hints.title: Alice Arrival Comparison
hints.text: When Alice reaches node u at time t, compare t with Bob's arrival time at u. If Alice arrives earlier, she collects the full reward; if simultaneously, half; if later, zero.

hints.title: Leaf Reward Maximization
hints.text: Perform a recursive traversal for Alice starting at node 0 and moving down towards leaf nodes, taking the maximum net profit among all reachable leaves.

hints.title: Timestamp Comparison Traversal Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Two depth traversals visit each vertex and edge a constant number of times.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all combinations of Alice and Bob movements on every possible leaf path repeats shared prefix calculations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for adjacency lists, Bob arrival map, and recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes Bob unique path timestamps before traversing Alice leaf paths.
